output: Always clear the selected 32-word DMA half before A2 calculation; model output remains in private RAM and is never routed to USB/headphones. Electrical transients unmeasured.

pages.7: model load status: 0 OK, 1 header, 2 CRC, 3 nonfinite/load rejection
pages.12: min accepted raw cycles, UINT32_MAX before any accepted span
pages.15: last sample of last batch, float32 bits
pages.17: phase: 0 waiting, 1 running, 2 complete, 3 model/output fault

internal_request_lengths: 4 for version and 9 for extension, excluding F7
coherent_result_rule: Wait for phase 2 or 3. Read complete pages twice; require status words 7..22 to agree. Callback count may advance. Phase 3 is a fault, not a timing result.
timing_acceptance_rule: Require phase 2, runs 512, load_status 0, invalid_cycles 0, nonfinite_outputs 0, no bad buffers, sensible nonzero min/max/sum and enabled stable DWT/DEMCR flags. Any violation blocks performance interpretation.
timing_scope: Raw A2 process call only, excludes ISR latency, housekeeping, output clear, input generation and telemetry cost. No independent reference timer, continuous deadline or DMA-release tracking.
counter_reset_limit: The stock delay service resets CYCCNT. The reader does not write DWT; a reset/preemption occurring inside a sample may not always be detected.
